title: Zara Zebra's Musical Crossing | Rhythm Story for Kids

music.emotional_arrangement: curious marimba and gentle shaker at the empty road; measured bass pulses for stop-look-listen and construction; tuned brass notes as six stripes settle; friendly call-and-response from the curbs; a warm walking groove for the first crossing; full marimba, drum, bell, flute and chorus only in the finale

continuity.zara: one friendly young zebra with crisp black-and-cream stripes, warm brown eyes, coral-tipped upright mane, teal community-helper vest, coral wrist bands and tan satchel
continuity.nuru: one small sandy meerkat with round teal glasses, mustard cap, plum clipboard and picture rhythm tokens
continuity.town: one handcrafted terracotta savannah square with jacaranda trees, market awnings and raised curbs

scenes.action: Zara and Nuru study an empty road from the curb while both market carts wait behind wooden blocks and families remain on raised curbs.
lyrics: Carts wait; families need a path.
scenes.hero: the empty road and safe need

scenes.action: Zara demonstrates stop, look and listen entirely from the curb while Nuru holds three picture tokens and the carts remain blocked.
Inside a roped closed work zone, Zara, Nuru and helpers align exactly six broad ivory stripes in one straight crossing row.
lyrics: Straight and wide across the road.

scenes.action: Each of the six stripes now holds one brass resonator; Zara taps the first and Nuru tunes the sixth while the road stays closed.
lyrics: Zara taps the first warm note.

scenes.action: Zara signals stop and Nuru checks the sight line; the crossing stays empty while both carts remain behind blocks and a stop line.
lyrics: Test it twice before we cheer.

scenes.action: With the road still roped closed, Zara plays a two-two pattern on the first two resonators and families copy with instruments from the curbs.
Exactly one gazelle parent and two children hold hands and cross together while Zara stops the carts and Nuru welcomes them at the destination curb.
lyrics: Slow safe steps make a melody.

scenes.action: A single-file community procession carries small acoustic instruments across in one direction with spacing while carts remain stopped.
With the street closed for the first full concert, Zara conducts while Nuru and the neighbors perform around all six glowing stripes.
lyrics: Safe steps and strong beats, sing!
